title: peer reachable but tcp 443 refused (nothing listening)
titleZh: 对端可达但 443 拒绝(nothing listening)
why: Refused and timeout mean different things: refused says the packet was answered, so the ACL is fine but tailscale serve is not up. The verdict keys must be distinct, otherwise the troubleshooting hint is wrong.
inject: TCP probe result for 203.0.113.5:443 replaced by 'refused'
